en: The image is a vintage-style colored postcard depicting a panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of a rocky mountain. The town features several buildings, a train station, train tracks, and winding roads. In the background, distinct architectural structures are visible, likely historical landmarks. The bottom of the postcard contains printed text in Portuguese.
